comments.comment: Why? Because you killed your child? You think that was the right choice? So sad how people can murder other humans just for the sake of unaliving them and think they are in the right for doing so...
How was it the right choice?
Then it was not the right choice
Maybe if she knew her poor, innocent baby was ripped apart and its body sold for parts she might actually realize what she did and that it was not, in fact, the right choice.
Removing a tumor or a parasite doesn't cause any pain or grief.
Imagine the difference if she had carried to term, placed her child for adoption and had continued her life with life affirming contact with her child...
Murdering is never the right choice.
